correctness.rationale: The terminal forbidden patterns have lengths three and six, so the five-symbol suffix is sufficient. Letter-renaming orbits are exact weighted bisimulation. A 49-state integer matrix has characteristic polynomial t^41 Q(t), checked with an exact symbolic program. Cayley–Hamilton yields the eighth-order recurrence from n>=49; the explicitly checked range n=11..48 closes the all-n proof and gives P(z). The only cyclic SCC has 30 vertices and a self-loop; Perron–Frobenius gives the asymptotic. A separate literal-letter direct enumeration through n=11 and DP through n=130 corroborate, not replace, the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The shortest two Abelian-cube block periods are a natural first nontrivial finite-type outer approximation to the full ternary Abelian-cube-free language. An exact rational all-length enumeration and entropy 2.607914749... quantifies the substantial remaining influence of longer forbidden periods, as the full-language published upper growth 2.371237 shows. A simple textbook identity or arbitrary selected slice would not give this motivated cutoff and sharp spectral law.
